data: What is the approximate value of the red line at the 8th epoch in the bottom graph labeled '(b) EER'?

The red line represents the 'without pretrain' condition, while the blue line represents the 'with pretrain' condition. The y-axis of the bottom graph is labeled 'EER', which stands for Equal Error Rate. The x-axis represents the number of epochs trained. 

At the 8th epoch, the red line (without pretrain) appears to be around the 0.3 mark on the y-axis. Therefore, the approximate value of the red line at the 8th epoch in the bottom graph labeled '(b) EER' is approximately 0.3.
